title: VMware vCenter RCE Gives Attackers a Path From One Appliance to Entire Virtual Infrastructure
content_md: A critical VMware vCenter vulnerability is being actively exploited in a fast-moving campaign that turns a single exposed management appliance into a launch point for broad virtual-infrastructure compromise. Incident responders at QUIRSO linked the activity to exploitation of CVE-2026-59310, while identifying a separate, possibly unrelated track involving CVE-2026-59309.
